description: Use this when the user wants to modify an existing export template.

email.description: New default recipient for exports from this template that are sent by email. Leave it out to keep it, or pass an empty string to clear it.

exportedFields.description: Columns, in order, as field IDs from export_fields, with the field scope that export_report_types names for the report type. Leave it out to keep the current columns. Only for report types that take columns.

filename.description: File name of the template's exports, up to 50 characters, without extension. Leave it out to keep it, or pass an empty string for "timesheet".

filter.description: Billing status: all, billable, notBillable, paid, unpaid (billable, not paid), billed or outstanding (billed, not paid). Leave it out to keep the current setting.

format.description: File format: xlsx (Excel), xlsx1904 (Excel with the 1904 date system), csv or pdf. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

name.description: New template name. Leave it out to keep the current one.

projectIds.description: Only entries of these projects (IDs from project_list). Leave it out to keep the current filter; an empty array removes it.

report.description: New report type (IDs from export_report_types). Leave it out to keep the current one.

splitTask.description: Split each entry at its breaks: one row per stretch of work, without the break columns. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

summarize.description: Add a totals row at the end; the entries are still listed. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

tagIds.description: Only entries with these tags (IDs from tag_list). Leave it out to keep the current filter; an empty array removes it.

teamIds.description: Only entries of these teams (IDs from team_list). Leave it out to keep the current filter; an empty array removes it.

title.description: Heading printed at the top of the template's PDF exports, such as "Hours report, Jane Smith", up to 255 characters. Leave it out to keep the current one, or pass an empty string to go back to the report's name. Only used when format is pdf: Excel and CSV exports have no title row.

type.description: Entry type: all, task (time entries), mileage or call. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

userIds.description: Only entries of these members (user IDs). Leave it out to keep the current filter; an empty array removes it.

name: export_template_update
title: Update Export Template
